text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained p95 inference latency in eu-central-1 (>900ms over 5m). Rule: inference_p95_by_region{region="eu-central-1"} > 900ms for 5m. Current p95=1.05s. customer_error_rate ~4.8%

Maya Patel: seeing huge spike at 07:42 CET on dashboard. Affects embedding and chat endpoints. Some clients on Dedicated pools reporting timeouts.

Noah Reyes: checking autoscaler logs; scale events fired but new pods report "ImagePullBackOff" in euc-az2. Registry throttling?

Ola Svensson: I can access the node events: `kubectl -n infra describe pod inference-xyz` shows image pull backoff due to quota limit from our private registry (reg-hosted). I'm opening infra ticket with container registry team.

Maya Patel: good catch. In parallel, can we divert traffic off eu-central-1 to eu-west-1 for non-low-latency SLAs? Suggest temporary route weight shift: `redwoodctl traffic shift --from eu-central-1 --to eu-west-1 --percent 35`

Noah Reyes: doing the shift now. Also creating a mitigation runbook step in incident doc to surface to customer-facing ops.

oncall-bot: Reminder: @SRE Rotation is oncall for hardware escalation in 30m.

SRE Rotation: I'm available, will join if needed.

Maya Patel: paging decision: the alert is P2 but error rate near 5% and multiple customers affected. I recommend paging infra primary and the registry owner.

Noah Reyes: paging infra-primary and registry-team leads.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: triggered page to infra-primary, registry-team, and eng-oncall. Incident ID: INC-1991.

Ola Svensson: workaround idea: apply image cache warm pool for euc-az2 nodes and pre-pull images to new nodes. Command: `gcloud compute ssh control-plane --command "docker pull reg-hosted/redwood/inference:stable"` executed on new nodes.

Maya Patel: do that. Also, to reduce immediate customer impact, let's lower model concurrency per pod so slow pods don't amplify queuing: `kubectl set env deploy/inference CONCURRENCY=2 -n customer-prod`

Noah Reyes: applied concurrency change. p95 has dropped to ~820ms, errors ~2.2% after traffic shift and concurrency change. Still above target but improving.

Maya Patel: suggest short mute of page notifications for this alert while we stabilize, but keep the alert firing to create a ticket. That prevents repeated wakeups. Set temporary PD silence for 20m with note.

SRE Rotation: agree, but please annotate incident doc with exact reasons for silence.

Noah Reyes: `pd silence create --service inference --duration 20m --note "temporary suppress pages while we mitigate imagepull backoff; ticketing maintained"` done.

Maya Patel: ops checklist to capture in post-incident tasks:
- increase registry rate limits for our CI/CD and node pre-pulls (Ola)
- add an image-pull alert: >3 pods in CrashLoopBackOff due to ImagePull errors for 3m (Noah)
- revise alert routing: page only when (error_rate > 3% AND p95 > 1.5s) OR (sustained pod failures >5) (Maya + Ops)
- create dashboard panel: per-az image-pull success rate and node pre-pull status (Ola)

Ola Svensson: drafting Prometheus rules for image-pull and combined signal. Quick proposal: ```yaml
- alert: ImagePullFailureHigh
  expr: sum(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="ImagePullBackOff"}) by (zone) > 3
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
- alert: InferenceServiceCritical
  expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)) > 1.5) and (sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(request_total[5m])) by (region) > 0.03)
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

Noah Reyes: that looks reasonable — note the error_rate threshold lower than previous drafts because many of our customers have tighter SLAs.

Maya Patel: also add a derived ticket-only alert: p95 > 900ms for 10m to prompt runbook but not page. We want to capture noisy transient blips as actionable tickets.

incident-bot: Update: registry-team acknowledged quota issue at 07:58 CET. They've temporarily lifted throttle for our pull tokens.

Noah Reyes: image pulls completing now; new pods reached Ready state in euc-az2. Rolling restart not needed.

Maya Patel: removing traffic shift, `redwoodctl traffic shift --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --percent 35` — gradual over 10m.

Noah Reyes: traffic rebalanced. p95 back to 420ms, error rate 0.4%.

SRE Rotation: I'm taking the watch for the next 90m. Maya, I'll take full handoff at 09:15 CET. Please document any open customer comms.

Maya Patel: documented. Filing follow-up PRs: alert-routes update (PR #289), image-pull alert (PR #290), per-az dashboard panel (internal link to grafana). Tagging Ops and customers team for review.

Ola Svensson: created dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/inference-az-status. Will add to incident doc.

Noah Reyes: post-incident action items added to ticket INC-1991: increase registry quotas, add image-pull alerts, update PD escalation mapping so that severity=page hits infra-primary + oncall, severity=ticket opens ops-ticket channel only.

Maya Patel: quick retrospective note: we should avoid blanket threshold bumps during incidents. Prefer selective routing, pre-pull strategies, and combined-signal paging. We'll discuss formal policy updates in next oncall sync.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1991 moved to monitoring. Final state: mitigated, owners=[Maya Patel, Noah Reyes, Ola Svensson], duration 32m.

SRE Rotation: Thanks team. Closing notes: will follow up on PR reviews and schedule 30m blameless postmortem tomorrow.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone, great coordination. :raised_hands:
